summary: Tested VBIE (Verified Buyer Intelligence Engine) — backend APIs (/api/buyers/*) and frontend pages (/buyers, /buyers/:geid). All 11 backend pytest cases passed (meta, search default/country/sector/corridor/trust_min/q, buyer detail, evidence, 404, claim). Frontend rendered 12 buyer cards correctly (NOT stuck on 'Searching…'), filters (Market/Sector/search) worked reactively, buyer profile displayed with trust breakdown (6 factors) + 4 evidence sources, and claim modal submitted successfully showing 'Request received' success state. The earlier screenshot artifact was indeed a lazy-load timing issue — cards render fine in a real browser.

issues: Cookie-consent banner overlaps bottom of the buyer profile (Source evidence section) at 1080p — pre-existing site-wide banner, not VBIE-specific.

critical_code_review_comments: vbie.py compute_trust: score cap at 100 works, but Verified band threshold=80 combined with source-reliability base (max 100 * 0.7 = 70) means only entities with signals achieve 'Verified' band — verify this is intentional.
search /buyers/search: q-regex uses raw user input; consider escaping regex metachars to avoid ReDoS on malicious queries.
claim endpoint returns 200 (should ideally be 201 Created) — cosmetic.
BuyerIntelligence.jsx: uses default select styling with dark bg — options list on some browsers may show system chrome; acceptable.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ buyer_claim inserted via POST /api/buyers/{geid}/claim during pytest; harmless (leads mirror row also inserted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: VBIE endpoints are stable at /api/buyers/*. 12 illustrative buyers seeded in `entities` (entity_type=buyer). Frontend routes /buyers and /buyers/:geid work. Data-testids: buyer-search-input, buyer-filter-country/sector/corridor/trust, buyer-result-count, buyer-card-N, buyer-profile-header, trust-factor-N, buyer-evidence-N, buyer-claim-btn, buyer-claim-modal, claim-name/email/company/message/submit/close.
rca of the issue: The 'Searching…' screenshot the main agent saw was a snapshot taken before the debounced (250ms) search fired — verified by real-browser test that count updates to '12 verified buyers' and grid renders 12 cards within ~1s.
